rows.answer:
根据提供的文档，ViT（Vision Transformer）的图像分类输入是经过处理的图像块。具体来说，输入图像首先被重塑为一维序列的令牌嵌入。[参考文档3：vit.pdf；第3页（物理页码）]中提到，输入图像 \( x \in \mathbb{R}^{H \times W \times C} \) 被重塑为一个一维序列。

对于DeiT，当前知识库中未找到直接说明其训练数据来源的文档。根据提供的信息，DeiT模型在ImageNet-1k上进行了微调，但未具体说明初始预训练数据集。某些ViT模型是在JFT-300M数据集上预训练的，但未明确指出DeiT是否使用了相同的预训练数据集。[参考文档2：deit.pdf；第5页（物理页码）]

questions.question: ViT论文在模型规模实验中使用了哪三个训练数据集？
questions.reference_answer: ImageNet（ILSVRC-2012）、ImageNet-21k和JFT。

questions.question: Which dataset does DeiT use for training without external data?
questions.reference_answer: DeiT trains on ImageNet only, without external training images.

questions.question: Swin Transformer初始输入patch的大小和原始RGB特征维度分别是多少？
questions.reference_answer: patch为4×4像素，拼接RGB值后为4×4×3=48维。

questions.question: How many stages does PVT use, and what are their output strides?
questions.reference_answer: PVT has four stages with output strides 4, 8, 16 and 32.

questions.question: T2T-ViT的两个主要架构组成是什么？
questions.reference_answer: 逐步聚合局部结构的Tokens-to-Token模块，以及深窄Transformer骨干。

questions.question: In CaiT’s class-attention stage, which embeddings are updated?
questions.reference_answer: Only the class embedding is updated; the processed patch embeddings remain fixed in this stage.
answer_points: Patch embeddings fixed in class-attention stage

questions.question: DETR的COCO 2017实验训练集和验证集分别约有多少张图像？
questions.reference_answer: 约11.8万张训练图像和5000张验证图像。

questions.question: What default training schedule is stated for Deformable DETR?
questions.reference_answer: The default schedule is 50 epochs, with a learning-rate drop at epoch 40.

questions.question: Conditional DETR报告了哪些标准COCO检测指标？
questions.reference_answer: AP、AP50、AP75，以及小、中、大目标的AP（APS/APM/APL）。

questions.question: What do the four coordinates in a DAB-DETR anchor query represent?
questions.reference_answer: The coordinates (x,y,w,h) represent box center and width/height; they are updated across decoder layers.

questions.question: DN-DETR摘要中，ResNet-50骨干训练12轮和50轮分别取得多少AP？
questions.reference_answer: 12轮43.4 AP，50轮48.6 AP；这两项结果均明确限定为论文的ResNet-50设置。

questions.question: Which three improvements are named in the DINO detection paper?
questions.reference_answer: Contrastive denoising, mixed query selection, and look forward twice.

questions.question: ViT采用什么位置编码来保留patch位置信息？
questions.reference_answer: 添加标准可学习的一维位置编码。

questions.question: How does DETR handle predictions that are unmatched to objects?
questions.reference_answer: They are supervised as the no-object class; the target set is padded with no-object entries.

questions.question: DINO使用ResNet-50、多尺度特征时，12轮和24轮的COCO AP分别是多少？
questions.reference_answer: 分别为49.4 AP和51.3 AP，不能混同于Swin-L加Objects365预训练的结果。

questions.question: How do the data regimes studied by ViT and DeiT differ?
questions.reference_answer: ViT studies ImageNet, ImageNet-21k and JFT scaling; DeiT emphasizes ImageNet-only training without external data.

questions.question: ViT和T2T-ViT的图像token化方式有什么区别？
questions.reference_answer: ViT将固定patch线性映射；T2T-ViT通过重叠soft split反复聚合邻近token，建模局部结构并缩短序列。

questions.question: How is class-token processing different in ViT and CaiT?
questions.reference_answer: ViT processes class and patch tokens together; CaiT first processes patches, then updates the class embedding through separate class-attention layers.

questions.question: ViT与Swin Transformer在注意力范围和层级结构上有什么区别？
questions.reference_answer: ViT主要采用全局patch自注意力；Swin采用交替窗口/移动窗口，并用patch merging构成层级特征。

questions.question: How do Swin and PVT reduce the cost of attention differently?
questions.reference_answer: Swin restricts attention to local windows; PVT’s SRA reduces the spatial lengths of keys and values.

questions.question: DETR和Deformable DETR的交叉注意力读取图像特征的方式有何不同？
questions.reference_answer: DETR关注编码器的全局特征；Deformable DETR围绕参考点采样少量位置，且支持多尺度特征。

questions.question: What does Conditional DETR add to the original DETR localization mechanism?
questions.reference_answer: It adds a decoder-conditioned spatial query that narrows each head’s localization range, reducing reliance on high-quality content embeddings.
answer_points: DETR relies heavily on content embeddings

questions.question: Conditional DETR与DAB-DETR在空间查询中利用目标尺寸的方式有什么差异？
questions.reference_answer: Conditional DETR以条件空间查询限定定位范围；DAB-DETR进一步把中心和宽高写成4D框，并用宽高调节注意力范围。

evidence.section: 3 What Is the Role of DETR Queries

questions.question: What changes does DN-DETR introduce on top of DAB-DETR?
questions.reference_answer: DAB-DETR introduces dynamic box queries; DN-DETR adds noisy-ground-truth reconstruction as auxiliary training to stabilize matching.

questions.question: DN-DETR与DINO的去噪监督有什么区别？
questions.reference_answer: DN-DETR重建加噪真值；DINO增加对比去噪：正查询重建真值，负查询预测无目标。

questions.question: How does DINO initialize query positions differently from DN-DETR?
questions.reference_answer: DN-DETR uses image-independent learned anchors; DINO initializes anchors from selected encoder features while keeping content queries learnable.

questions.question: ViT与PVT为什么对密集预测的输出适配性不同？
questions.reference_answer: ViT保留单尺度token序列；PVT以逐级缩小的四阶段输出多尺度特征，更便于接入密集预测模型。

questions.question: How do DeiT and CaiT add mechanisms for producing the image-level prediction?
questions.reference_answer: DeiT adds a teacher-supervised distillation token alongside the class token; CaiT separates patch processing from class-attention summarization.

questions.question: T2T-ViT和PVT都缩短token序列，但两者设计目标有何侧重差异？
questions.reference_answer: T2T-ViT聚合局部结构以提高分类训练效率；PVT通过金字塔形成多尺度特征，服务检测等密集预测。

questions.question: Compare the reported DETR and Deformable DETR training schedules without making a wall-clock speed claim.
questions.reference_answer: DETR’s Faster R-CNN comparison uses 500 epochs; Deformable DETR defaults to 50. Epoch counts do not establish a universal latency ratio.

questions.question: 综合ViT、DeiT、Swin与DETR，列举分类与检测实验的数据集，并区分用途。
questions.reference_answer: ViT用ImageNet/21k/JFT研究分类训练规模；DeiT只用ImageNet；Swin与DETR在COCO上做检测。

questions.question: Summarize task-specific quality metrics from DeiT, Swin and Conditional DETR.
questions.reference_answer: Classification uses top-1 accuracy; detection uses AP and its threshold/size variants; Swin’s segmentation experiments use mIoU.

questions.question: 综合Swin、PVT和Deformable DETR，多尺度特征分别通过什么方式进入视觉任务？
questions.reference_answer: Swin通过patch merging形成层级；PVT通过四阶段金字塔输出；Deformable DETR在多个尺度特征上稀疏采样。

questions.question: Summarize the different explanations of slow DETR training in Conditional DETR and DN-DETR.
questions.reference_answer: Conditional DETR highlights difficult content-dependent localization; DN-DETR highlights unstable bipartite matching and inconsistent early optimization targets.

questions.question: 按Conditional DETR、DAB-DETR、DINO归纳空间查询逐渐增强的设计信息。
questions.reference_answer: Conditional使用条件空间查询；DAB加入框中心与宽高并逐层更新；DINO再用encoder选中的位置初始化anchor。

questions.question: Organize the improvement strategies of DeiT, T2T-ViT and CaiT into three architectural or training themes.
questions.reference_answer: DeiT emphasizes distillation; T2T-ViT emphasizes local token aggregation and efficient backbones; CaiT emphasizes deep-network optimization and separate class attention.

questions.question: 结合ViT、Swin、PVT，归纳控制注意力计算量的主要设计方向。
questions.reference_answer: ViT的全局序列作为参照；Swin限制窗口大小；PVT压缩K/V空间长度并采用金字塔。复杂度结论需注明输入和固定参数。

questions.question: What preserves the end-to-end set-prediction formulation across DETR, DAB-DETR and DN-DETR?
questions.reference_answer: They retain decoder predictions and bipartite matching; DAB changes query geometry and DN adds training supervision rather than restoring conventional NMS pipelines.

questions.question: 综合ViT、DINO与Conditional DETR，比较论文实验结果时至少要核对哪些设置？
questions.reference_answer: 核对任务/数据与划分、预训练数据、骨干、输入或多尺度、训练轮数及参数/计算量；不直接跨设置比较AP或accuracy。

questions.question: Which training-only information is removed from inference in DeiT and DN-DETR?
questions.reference_answer: DeiT’s student predicts through class/distillation heads without the teacher; DN-DETR removes noisy-GT denoising queries and retains its matching branch.
answer_points: No teacher needed for DeiT student inference

questions.question: 综合Swin、PVT和Deformable DETR，归纳支持不同目标尺度的设计。
questions.reference_answer: Swin/PVT输出分层多尺度特征；Deformable DETR从多尺度特征采样，并针对DETR的小目标和高分辨率瓶颈改进。

questions.question: Besides accuracy, which efficiency measures appear in DeiT and T2T-ViT?
questions.reference_answer: DeiT reports image throughput; T2T-ViT reports parameter counts and MACs. These describe efficiency, not answer-quality or retrieval metrics.

questions.question: 综合DAB-DETR、DN-DETR和DINO，归纳DINO沿用的基础设计及三个新增方向。
questions.reference_answer: 基础包括动态anchor与去噪训练；DINO新增对比去噪、混合查询选择和利用相邻层梯度信息的两次前瞻。

questions.question: Group ViT, T2T-ViT, CaiT, PVT and Swin by the visual tasks emphasized in their designs.
questions.reference_answer: ViT, T2T-ViT and CaiT emphasize classification; PVT and Swin provide versatile backbones for classification and dense prediction.

questions.question: 从ViT、DETR及Conditional DETR中归纳三种不能忽略的实验或适用性限制。
questions.reference_answer: ViT小数据训练受弱归纳偏置影响；DETR有小目标与长训练问题；Conditional的某些对比因参数和计算量不同并非完全公平。

questions.question: Why can large-scale pretraining compensate for ViT’s weaker convolutional inductive biases?
questions.reference_answer: The paper argues that sufficient data allows the model to learn visual regularities otherwise supplied by stronger architectural priors.
answer_points: Paper-specific evidence, not a universal guarantee

questions.question: DeiT的卷积教师优势能否直接证明归纳偏置已被传入学生？为什么？
questions.reference_answer: 不能。论文观察到卷积教师更好及预测更相关，但明确表示难以正式回答归纳偏置是否继承，不能把相关性当作机制证明。
answer_points: Author says formal explanation is difficult
questions.answer_basis: 作者明确说明的证据局限

questions.question: Why does Swin alternate regular and shifted windows instead of keeping one fixed partition?
questions.reference_answer: Fixed windows isolate groups; shifted partitions enable neighboring-window communication while retaining efficient local attention.

questions.question: 为什么PVT同时采用金字塔和SRA，而不是直接沿用ViT做高分辨率检测骨干？
questions.reference_answer: 检测需高分辨率及多尺度；金字塔产生不同尺度，SRA缩短K/V以减少注意力资源开销，缓解ViT单尺度和长序列瓶颈。
questions.answer_basis: 作者设计动机与机制组合

questions.question: Why should T2T-ViT’s overlapping aggregation help ImageNet-only training?
questions.reference_answer: The paper argues that neighboring-token aggregation preserves local structure missed by hard splitting, improving the efficiency of learning visual features.
questions.answer_basis: 作者提出的假设及设计论证

questions.question: LayerScale为什么用小初值的逐通道可学习缩放来帮助训练更深的CaiT？
questions.reference_answer: 小初值让残差路径初期贡献较小、模型接近恒等映射；逐通道权重可逐渐调节，比单个缩放标量提供更多优化自由度。

questions.question: Why is one-to-one matching important for DETR’s NMS-free prediction design?
questions.reference_answer: It gives each target one matched prediction, while unmatched outputs receive no-object supervision, encouraging unique set predictions instead of post-hoc duplicate suppression.

questions.question: 为什么Deformable DETR的稀疏采样更适合高分辨率和小目标，而不是全局密集注意力？
questions.reference_answer: 高分辨率使全局注意力代价高；参考点附近少量采样降低开销，允许多尺度高分辨率特征，改善小目标信息利用。

questions.question: Why does Conditional DETR reduce the need for highly discriminative content embeddings during localization?
questions.reference_answer: Conditional spatial queries restrict each head to a relevant band, separating part of localization from content-only matching and easing optimization.

questions.question: 为什么DAB-DETR在空间查询中使用宽高，而不只使用中心坐标？
questions.reference_answer: 中心只给出位置；宽高还表达目标尺度和形状，能调节注意力范围，使查询更适应不同大小目标并形成soft ROI聚合。

evidence.section: 3 What Is the Role of DETR Queries

questions.question: Why can DN-DETR’s noisy-GT reconstruction stabilize early training despite retaining Hungarian matching?
questions.reference_answer: Reconstruction supplies consistent auxiliary targets while matching assignments fluctuate, easing query learning without replacing the set-prediction loss.

questions.question: DN-DETR为什么必须屏蔽匹配查询对去噪查询的访问以及去噪组之间的访问？
questions.reference_answer: 否则匹配查询可能看到含真值的去噪输入，或不同噪声组相互泄漏答案，产生训练捷径，损害没有去噪输入的推理。

questions.question: Why does DINO initialize positions from encoder features but leave content queries learnable?
questions.reference_answer: Preliminary encoder content may mix objects or show only object parts; position-only initialization avoids misleading content while retaining useful location priors.

questions.question: DINO为什么增加预测无目标的负去噪查询，而不只重建正样本？
questions.reference_answer: 只重建附近真值不足以学会拒绝无目标anchor；负查询提供拒绝监督，帮助减少相邻anchor混淆及重复预测。
answer_points: Reject poor anchors and reduce confusion
No guarantee of eliminating all duplicates

questions.question: With only ImageNet available, which collected approaches offer better-supported starting points than requiring JFT pretraining, and why?
questions.reference_answer: DeiT and T2T-ViT explicitly study ImageNet-only training. Their distillation or local-token designs provide evidence-based options, without guaranteeing published accuracy on new hardware.
questions.answer_basis: 基于指定论文的场景推断，非新增实验证明
